binvox 3D mesh voxelizer, keywords: voxelization, voxelisation, 3D model
Introduction binvox is a straight-forward program that reads a 3D model file, rasterizes it into a binary 3D voxel grid, and writes the resulting voxel file. It's a "spin-off" program of software I wrote while a graduate student at Princeton. Features input formats: nearly 100% VRML 2.0 support will parse Wavefront OBJ, Geomview OFF, Autocad DXF, PLY and STL, if they contain polygons only VRML ...
